visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long reddish-brown hair and a grey sweater sits indoors, holding a green velvet bow keychain with two Crybaby plush dolls (one pink, one red). She points to a green plastic hook at the top. (2) Close-up shot focusing on the green hook and the texture of the velvet bow as her hands manipulate them. (3) A black-and-white sequence shows her looking disappointed while holding the keychain; yellow subtitle text appears at the bottom. (4) Transition to a series of product showcase clips: the dolls are shown against a pink heart background, then a photo of a celebrity (Lisa from Blackpink) carrying a bag with the same dolls is displayed. (5) Screenshots of shopping websites are shown, highlighting prices for the 'Crybaby Cherry Much' series. (6) The woman returns to the screen, demonstrating how the keychain looks on different luxury bags: a brown Hermès mini bolide, a black backpack, a brown leather satchel, a Loewe straw tote, and a large black Chanel Deauville. (7) Final sequence shows alternative ways to style the keychain, including clipping it to a waistband and a smartphone, ending with a close-up of the dolls on a red-and-white checkered plate.

(2) A short, sliding 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the camera zooms. The voice maintains a high pitch and rapid pace. (3) A comical 'buzzer' or 'fail' sound effect plays during the black-and-white segment. (4) Upbeat music continues with a heavy 4/4 electronic drum beat. Vocal delivery remains bubbly and enthusiastic. (5) Frequent 'pop' and 'magic sparkle' SFX are layered to highlight product features and bag brands. (6) Narrative concludes with a warm, rising intonation and a final celebratory chime effect.
